# C2C Rental

> Affordable, fully-insured car rentals in Surrey, Langley, and Abbotsford, BC — transparent pricing, flexible pickup, and 24/7 local support.

C2C Rental is a locally owned car rental company serving the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland in British Columbia, Canada. We rent economy sedans, mid-size SUVs, and 7-seat minivans by the day, week, and month, with pickup and delivery across Surrey Newton, Langley Centre, and Abbotsford Centre. Vehicles are insured under ICBC and maintained between every rental.
